newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close sharply lower at settlement end.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close sharply lower at settlement end.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed sharply lower on Friday as investors and speculators squared their positions on the last day of the current settlement period, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 11.46 points lower at 769.14 points.

Traders said the absence of foreign buying, and reluctance of speculators and investors to stake fresh claims ahead of the end of the current financial year on March 31 also pushed share prices lower.

"The business was largely of position-squaring throughout the session as operators were unable to manage funds to take deliveries and were forced to unload their positions," said S.C. Juneja of brokers Jaico Credit.
ACC plunged 65 rupees to 1,461 on heavy selling by speculators, brokers said.
Reliance Industries fell 4.85 rupees to 286.75 as speculators squared positions, they said.
Larsen and Toubro shed 5.60 rupees to 216.90.
